selected_idea.title: The Bite He Said He Didn't Want
selected_idea.one_line_concept: Aachu has food; Zuv says he is not hungry but his eyes and hand are already negotiating with her plate.
selected_idea.format: single first-slide illustration for a later 5-slide carousel
selected_idea.exact_on_image_text:
he said "i'm not hungry"
so why is my plate nervous?
selected_idea.emotional_truth: Some couple thefts are annoying because they are accurate, and sweet because they happen only with your person.
selected_idea.share_trigger: A viewer can send this as a half-joking accusation to the partner who refuses food until it is on someone else's plate.
selected_idea.why_generic_version_fails: It explains a sentiment instead of staging the suspicious plate, the stolen bite energy, and the partner-specific accusation.
